name: eli5
title_zh: 把任何概念讲成带大图的幼儿园绘本
tagline_zh: 正文只有一句：「把我当成对这个话题完全不懂的人，用大图、少字的 HTML 页面讲明白。」输出不是一段话，是一页能顺着往下看的图文。
tagline_en: The whole body is one line: explain like I know nothing, as an HTML page with big pictures and few words.
desc_en: The whole body is one line: explain like I know nothing, as an HTML page with big pictures and few words.
why_zh: 它证明 skill 不必复杂：改变的不是信息量，是理解路径——从「读一大段」变成「顺着标题和图往下看」。
why_en: It shows a skill need not be complex — what changes is not the amount of information but the path to understanding.
limit_zh: 整份 SKILL.md 只有一句指令，效果全看你的 agent 会不会做 HTML；不会出图的环境里它就退化成一段普通解释。装的是 anthropics/claude-plugins-community 这个 31 件合集里的一个路径。
limit_en: One sentence; the result depends entirely on whether your agent can render HTML. Installed as one path inside a 31-skill community plugin repo.
title_en: Explain anything as a big-picture HTML page for a total.
